recipe.title: Lemon tart
recipe.notes: I got this recipe from Alexandra Flaus, who made it for Chocolate Friday at Webb Henderson in December 2020.
recipe.prep: Preheat oven to 190 deg C (for pastry shell), then lower to 150 deg C (for the filling).

method.s: For the pastry shell: bought sweet short pastry is fine.
Press into the baking dish, then chill for 5 minutes. (Do not prick the base before cooking.)
Blind bake, using a layer of baking paper and then rice, for 10 to 15 minutes at 190 deg C.
Remove rice and baking paper, then bake for a further 5 minutes.
Remove from oven and allow pastry and dish to cool.
For the tart: melt butter in microwave until almost bubbling.
Add caster sugar and eggs. Beat well with a hand beater.
Add chilled lemon juice and mix well.
The filling should turn pale and thicken slightly when the lemon juice is added.
Pour into the cooked pastry shell and return to the oven.
Bake at 150 deg C until the filling is set but still has a slight wobble.
